metadata.status: Phase 1 inventory - ready for Phase 2A cleanup

strategy_analysis.name: Strategic Analysis
strategy_analysis.description: Frameworks for analyzing markets, industries, and competitive positioning

frameworks.name: Porter's Five Forces
frameworks.use_case: Analyze competitive forces in an industry
frameworks.recommended_when: Evaluating market attractiveness or competitive position
frameworks.avoid_when: Analyzing internal operational issues or tactical decisions

frameworks.name: SWOT Analysis
frameworks.use_case: Identify internal strengths/weaknesses and external opportunities/threats
frameworks.recommended_when: Starting strategic planning or major decision
frameworks.avoid_when: Detailed technical analysis or operational troubleshooting
frameworks.phase_3_relevance: Foundational for org wrapper strategic context

frameworks.name: PESTLE Analysis
frameworks.use_case: Analyze external macro-environmental factors
frameworks.recommended_when: Assessing impact of external factors on strategy

frameworks.name: Ansoff Matrix
frameworks.use_case: Evaluate growth strategies across product/market dimensions
frameworks.recommended_when: Planning growth strategy or product roadmap
frameworks.phase_3_relevance: Key for SaaS and platform businesses

frameworks.name: Strategy Diamond (Hambrick & Fredrickson)
frameworks.use_case: Comprehensive strategy framework covering all strategic dimensions
frameworks.recommended_when: Developing comprehensive strategy covering arenas, vehicles, differentiators, staging, economic logic

frameworks.name: Core Competency Model
frameworks.use_case: Identify unique capabilities that create competitive advantage
frameworks.recommended_when: Evaluating what capabilities to protect or develop

frameworks.name: Value Chain Analysis
frameworks.use_case: Analyze sources of competitive advantage across business activities
frameworks.recommended_when: Identifying where to create or capture value
frameworks.phase_3_relevance: Key for understanding org value creation

frameworks.name: Blue Ocean Strategy
frameworks.use_case: Create uncontested market space instead of competing in crowded markets
frameworks.recommended_when: Seeking to differentiate from competitors or create new markets

frameworks.name: Three Horizons Framework
frameworks.use_case: Balance current business with emerging opportunities and transformational innovation
frameworks.recommended_when: Planning multi-year strategy and innovation portfolio

growth_strategy.name: Growth Strategy
growth_strategy.description: Frameworks focused on expanding revenue, customer base, or market share

frameworks.name: Business Model Canvas
frameworks.use_case: Visual representation of how organization creates, delivers, and captures value
frameworks.recommended_when: Designing or restructuring business model
frameworks.phase_3_relevance: Important for org wrapper business context

frameworks.name: North Star Metric Framework
frameworks.use_case: Single metric that captures value delivered to customers
frameworks.recommended_when: Aligning organization around key success metric

frameworks.name: AARRR Growth Funnel (Pirate Metrics)
frameworks.use_case: Analyze customer lifecycle: Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, Revenue
frameworks.recommended_when: Optimizing user/customer acquisition and lifecycle

frameworks.name: Product-Led Growth
frameworks.use_case: Use product experience as primary driver of acquisition and retention
frameworks.recommended_when: Designing self-serve product experience or reducing sales friction
frameworks.avoid_when: Sales-led models or complex B2B enterprises

frameworks.name: Hooked Model (Nir Eyal)
frameworks.use_case: Create habit-forming products through trigger-action-reward cycles
frameworks.recommended_when: Designing for user engagement and retention

frameworks.name: Flywheel Growth Model
frameworks.use_case: Create self-reinforcing cycle where customer success drives acquisition
frameworks.recommended_when: Building growth momentum through customer advocacy

operations_improvement.name: Operations & Process Improvement
operations_improvement.description: Frameworks focused on improving efficiency, reducing waste, and optimizing workflows

frameworks.name: Lean Manufacturing
frameworks.use_case: Eliminate waste and optimize production processes
frameworks.recommended_when: Improving manufacturing or production efficiency
frameworks.avoid_when: Knowledge worker productivity or strategic decisions

frameworks.name: Theory of Constraints (TOC)
frameworks.use_case: Identify and remove system bottleneck limiting throughput
frameworks.recommended_when: System has clear bottleneck limiting performance

frameworks.name: Value Stream Mapping
frameworks.use_case: Visualize process flow and identify improvement opportunities
frameworks.recommended_when: Analyzing complex processes for waste and improvement

frameworks.name: Six Sigma
frameworks.use_case: Reduce variation and defects through statistical process control
frameworks.recommended_when: Improving quality and reducing process variation

frameworks.name: PDCA Cycle (Plan-Do-Check-Act)
frameworks.use_case: Continuous improvement through iterative testing and refinement
frameworks.recommended_when: Implementing continuous improvement culture

project_management.name: Project Management & PMO
project_management.description: Frameworks for planning, executing, and governing projects

frameworks.name: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)
frameworks.use_case: Decompose project into manageable work packages
frameworks.recommended_when: Starting project planning or defining scope

frameworks.name: Critical Path Method (CPM)
frameworks.use_case: Identify longest sequence of dependent tasks to determine project duration
frameworks.recommended_when: Managing complex projects with tight schedules

frameworks.name: RACI Matrix
frameworks.use_case: Clarify roles and responsibilities: Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed
frameworks.recommended_when: Defining roles for project or process

frameworks.name: DACI Matrix
frameworks.use_case: Clarify decision authority: Driver, Approver, Contributors, Informed
frameworks.recommended_when: Making important organizational decisions

frameworks.name: Agile Framework
frameworks.use_case: Iterative, incremental delivery with continuous feedback
frameworks.recommended_when: Projects with uncertain requirements or fast-moving environments

frameworks.name: Scrum
frameworks.use_case: Agile framework with sprints, standups, and retrospectives
frameworks.recommended_when: Implementing agile with defined roles and ceremonies

frameworks.name: Kanban
frameworks.use_case: Visualize workflow and limit work-in-progress
frameworks.recommended_when: Optimizing continuous flow or visualizing process

finance.name: Financial Performance & Capital Allocation
finance.description: Models for evaluating investments, profitability, and capital efficiency

frameworks.name: Net Present Value (NPV)
frameworks.use_case: Evaluate present value of future cash flows for investment decisions
frameworks.recommended_when: Comparing investment opportunities with different cash flow profiles

frameworks.name: Internal Rate of Return (IRR)
frameworks.use_case: Calculate annualized return on investment
frameworks.recommended_when: Comparing returns across different investments

frameworks.name: Return on Investment (ROI)
frameworks.use_case: Measure profitability relative to investment
frameworks.recommended_when: Evaluating efficiency of spending

frameworks.name: Economic Value Added (EVA)
frameworks.use_case: Measure economic profit after accounting for cost of capital
frameworks.recommended_when: Assessing whether initiatives create economic value

frameworks.name: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC)
frameworks.use_case: Calculate blended cost of equity and debt financing
frameworks.recommended_when: Evaluating investments against cost of capital

customer_marketing.name: Customer & Marketing
customer_marketing.description: Frameworks for understanding customer behavior and optimizing marketing

frameworks.name: Customer Journey Mapping
frameworks.use_case: Visualize customer experience across touchpoints
frameworks.recommended_when: Improving customer experience or identifying gaps

frameworks.name: Jobs To Be Done Framework
frameworks.use_case: Understand underlying customer motivations and desired outcomes
frameworks.recommended_when: Understanding why customers adopt products

frameworks.name: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
frameworks.use_case: Calculate cost of acquiring new customers through specific channels
frameworks.recommended_when: Evaluating marketing spend efficiency

frameworks.name: Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
frameworks.use_case: Estimate total profit from customer relationship over lifetime
frameworks.recommended_when: Determining sustainable acquisition spend

frameworks.name: Customer Churn Rate
frameworks.use_case: Measure percentage of customers lost during period
frameworks.recommended_when: Identifying retention problems or satisfaction issues

organizational_design.name: Organizational Design & Leadership
organizational_design.description: Frameworks for structuring organizations and defining leadership

frameworks.name: McKinsey 7S Framework
frameworks.use_case: Align seven organizational elements for effectiveness
frameworks.recommended_when: Assessing organizational effectiveness or planning transformation

frameworks.name: Galbraith Star Model
frameworks.use_case: Align strategy, structure, processes, rewards, and people
frameworks.recommended_when: Designing organization to support strategy

frameworks.name: Span of Control Analysis
frameworks.use_case: Determine optimal number of direct reports per manager
frameworks.recommended_when: Evaluating management layer effectiveness

frameworks.name: Decision Rights Matrix
frameworks.use_case: Define who has authority to make decisions in different areas
frameworks.recommended_when: Defining decision authority across organization

data_analytics.name: Data & Analytics
data_analytics.description: Frameworks for using data to inform decision-making

frameworks.name: KPI Trees
frameworks.use_case: Decompose high-level goals into measurable key performance indicators
frameworks.recommended_when: Defining measurement for strategic goals

frameworks.name: Balanced Scorecard
frameworks.use_case: Measure organizational performance across financial, customer, process, and learning dimensions
frameworks.recommended_when: Creating balanced view of organizational performance

frameworks.name: CRISP-DM (Data Mining Process)
frameworks.use_case: Structured process for data science projects: Business understanding, Data prep, Modeling, Evaluation, Deployment
frameworks.recommended_when: Conducting data science project

frameworks.name: Data Governance Framework
frameworks.use_case: Establish policies for data quality, security, privacy, and accessibility
frameworks.recommended_when: Establishing data governance practices

risk_decision_science.name: Risk Management & Decision Science
risk_decision_science.description: Frameworks for managing uncertainty and making decisions under uncertainty

frameworks.name: OODA Loop
frameworks.use_case: Rapid decision-making cycle: Observe, Orient, Decide, Act
frameworks.recommended_when: Operating in dynamic or competitive environment

frameworks.name: Scenario Planning
frameworks.use_case: Develop plausible future scenarios and prepare strategies for each
frameworks.recommended_when: Facing significant uncertainty in strategic planning

frameworks.name: Decision Trees
frameworks.use_case: Visualize decisions, outcomes, and expected values
frameworks.recommended_when: Evaluating complex decisions with multiple outcomes

frameworks.name: Bayesian Decision Analysis
frameworks.use_case: Update beliefs based on new evidence using probability
frameworks.recommended_when: Incorporating new evidence into decision-making

innovation.name: Innovation & Product Development
innovation.description: Frameworks for generating ideas and bringing products to market

frameworks.name: Lean Startup
frameworks.use_case: Reduce risk in new product development through rapid experimentation
frameworks.recommended_when: Testing new product ideas with limited resources

frameworks.name: Design Thinking
frameworks.use_case: Human-centered innovation: empathize, define, ideate, prototype, test
frameworks.recommended_when: Designing solutions for customer needs

frameworks.name: Innovation Ambition Matrix
frameworks.use_case: Categorize innovations by ambition level: core, adjacent, transformational
frameworks.recommended_when: Balancing innovation portfolio

missing_frameworks.name: High-Value Missing Frameworks (Phase 2 Additions)
missing_frameworks.description: Critical frameworks identified for addition during Phase 2 cleanup

frameworks.name: Strategic Group Mapping
frameworks.use_case: Visualize competitive positioning within industry
frameworks.recommended_when: Analyzing competitive landscape and positioning

frameworks.name: Lean Canvas
frameworks.use_case: Lightweight business model design for startups
frameworks.recommended_when: Designing business model with limited information

frameworks.name: SCOR Model (Supply Chain Operations Reference)
frameworks.use_case: Standardized framework for evaluating supply chain performance
frameworks.recommended_when: Evaluating or improving supply chain performance

frameworks.name: DuPont Analysis
frameworks.use_case: Decompose return on equity into component factors
frameworks.recommended_when: Understanding drivers of financial performance
